title: Behavioral anchor for the NT-sign convention: sugar/bitter feeding
prediction_source: Shiu et al. 2024 Fig 3a (bitter GRN co-stimulation suppresses sugar-driven feeding motor output)

substrate.snapshot: run-007: male-cns:v0.9 depth-2 closed subgraph around the 36 driven GRNs (40,290 neurons, 336,245 signed edges, 0 dangling)
substrate.driven_sugar: LB3b/LB3c (Gr64f+ sugar lbGRNs), right hemisphere, n=17
substrate.driven_bitter: LB1a-d (Gr33a+ bitter lbGRNs), right hemisphere, n=19
substrate.population_mapping_source: Cell 2026 gustatory connectome paper (MaleCNS-native lbGRN type names)
substrate.readout: MN9 (proboscis-extension motor neuron) firing rate; mean of MN9_R (16949) and MN9_L (10331)

protocol.drive: sugar 200 Hz, bitter 200 Hz (paper's Fig 3a high-drive contrast)
protocol.simulator: fly.dynamics.lif.simulate_lif (WP6b-validated against Shiu Brian2 reference, TOST p~0, rho=0.9999)
protocol.two_population_drive: stimulated2/r_poisson2_Hz pathway (reference poi() exc2 semantics; rfc=0; TDD'd in tests/test_two_population_drive.py)

arms.signed: pipeline NT convention: gaba, glutamate -> -1; ach -> +1; unknown -> +1 (5,794/40,290 neurons unknown, hub-under-represented)
arms.abl-glu: glutamate -> +1 (gaba kept inhibitory): 32,165 glutamatergic edges flipped positive
arms.all-pos: all weights positive (sign convention fully removed)

discriminating_outcome.verdict: PASS - the signed convention reproduces the paper's directional finding (bitter suppresses sugar-driven MN9 firing) and BOTH ablated conventions fail to reproduce it. The NT-sign assumption is load-bearing: GABA alone is insufficient - glutamatergic inhibition is specifically required for bitter-driven feeding suppression.

interpretation.signed: Bitter co-drive silences MN9 (40.6 -> 0.0 Hz), reproducing the paper's directional finding on MaleCNS.
interpretation.abl-glu: With glutamate excitatory, bitter co-drive INCREASES MN9 rate (51.5 -> 53.0 Hz): the suppression circuit depends on glutamatergic inhibition, not only GABA. Corroborates the Cell 2026 finding that lbGRN bitter signaling is (partly) glutamatergic.
interpretation.all-pos: Without signs, MN9 runs at ~88 Hz in both conditions - no suppression, and a 16x spike-count explosion (618K vs 39K mean): the unsigned graph is not merely quantitatively wrong, it produces a qualitatively different (epileptiform) network.

limitations: Population identity mapping (FlyWire GRNs -> MaleCNS lbGRN types) is from the Cell 2026 gustatory connectome paper, not from Shiu et al.; literature-based, recorded in wp6c_grn_seeds.json with per-neuron NT.
Directionality, not rate matching, is the tested prediction (different substrate: MaleCNS vs the paper's FlyWire male-CNS model).
MN9 firing rate is a scalar circuit proxy for proboscis extension, not a behavioral assay.
NT convention for 'unknown' neurons (14.4% here) defaults to +1; hub-bias check (WP6b) shows unknown-NT neurons are under-represented among out-weight hubs.
